name: vue-dotnet-monorepo-template
description: Root orchestration for the VueDotnet Monorepo template.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "dotnet watch --project backend/VueDotnet.Api/VueDotnet.Api.csproj --urls http://localhost:5000"
scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm --prefix frontend run build" "dotnet build backend/VueDotnet.sln --configuration Release"
scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm --prefix frontend run test:run" "dotnet test backend/VueDotnet.sln --configuration Release"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run type-check && dotnet format backend/VueDotnet.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix frontend exec -- prettier --write README.md SECURITY.md AGENTS.md backend/README.md package.json .github docker && dotnet format backend/VueDotnet.sln
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend exec -- prettier --check README.md SECURITY.md AGENTS.md backend/README.md package.json .github docker
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run type-check && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test:run && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check:backend: dotnet format backend/VueDotnet.sln --verify-no-changes --no-restore && dotnet test backend/VueDotnet.sln --configuration Release --no-restore && dotnet build backend/VueDotnet.sln --configuration Release --no-restore
scripts.docker:down: concurrently --success all "docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml down --remove-orphans" "docker compose -f docker/compose.server.yml -f docker/compose.build.yml down --remove-orphans"
